name: agent-status-monitor
description: A lightweight, zero-dependency side-pane monitor for Antigravity — combining agent phase, upstream network probes, and token usage so you can tell real progress from a silent "Working" hang at a glance.
suggestedPrompts: Open the Antigravity Status Monitor panel
Check whether the agent is actively working or silently hung
Set the status monitor stall threshold to 20 seconds
